transition_targets.label: Hosted validation executes real steps and succeeds
required_actions: Inspect the exact non-sensitive banner on the failed PR #123 validate job
Correct the actual GitHub Actions minutes, spending, billing, policy or runner-allocation restriction
Generate a valid GAR receipt from genuine observations
Rerun unchanged PR #123 exact head
required_evidence: Actual non-sensitive GitHub banner and restriction category
Successful exact-head workflow run with checkout and non-empty steps
Provider-discovery, Terraform, test and readiness artifact families
stop_conditions: PR #123 head changes
Hosted job again has zero steps
Any required artifact family is missing
GAR or GHR validation fails
Sensitive billing or secret material appears

transition_targets.label: GitHub Actions zero-step incident is resolved
required_actions: Review GAR, successful run, executed steps, logs, artifacts and GHR evidence
Post the non-sensitive recovery package to issue #124
Close issue #124 only after completion criteria are satisfied
required_evidence: Issue #124 contains valid GAR and GHR references
Exact successful run ID is recorded
Issue closure comment states no hosted-CI substitution
stop_conditions: Evidence is incomplete or stale
Run is not bound to exact PR #123 head
Issue closure would rely on local-only evidence

transition_targets.label: PR #123 is reviewed, admitted and main is verified
required_actions: Complete exact-head technical review of PR #123
Record a separate accountable-operator disposition
Merge with expected-head protection if approved
Record the resulting exact main revision
Run and verify hosted mainline CI
stop_conditions: PR head moves after review
Merge is attempted before separate disposition
Post-merge mainline CI does not execute real steps

transition_targets.label: PR #129 is rebound to verified main, validated and admitted
required_actions: Reconstruct or rebind the canonical sequence to the resulting exact main
Refresh all PR and issue revision bindings
Run canonical sequence and truth-procurement validators
Run complete hosted CI
Complete exact-head review and separate disposition
stop_conditions: Any binding remains stale
Hosted CI has zero steps
Safety invariants are weakened
PR #129 is merged before PR #123 admission

transition_targets.label: Staging plan and apply authorization train is reconstructed and admitted
required_actions: Reconstruct PR #121 scope on verified main rather than blindly retargeting
Preserve SIP exact-revision and project binding
Preserve SIA exact-plan digest binding and single-use expiration
Run complete repository and Terraform CI
Complete exact-head review and separate disposition
required_evidence: Terraform formatting, initialization, validation and inert-plan evidence
stop_conditions: Production release authority is reused for initial staging
Plan and apply authority are combined
A stale Terraform fingerprint or revision is accepted

transition_targets.label: Bounded Cloud Run staging runtime is implemented internally
required_actions: Add a non-root container definition and deterministic build surface
Expose /health readiness and liveness behavior
Add resource-gated Cloud Run v2 and Artifact Registry Terraform modules
Define runtime service account, Secret Manager references and private Cloud SQL connectivity
Produce SBOM, provenance, signature, vulnerability and deployment-manifest evidence
required_evidence: Cloud Run resource graph remains disabled by default
SBOM, provenance, signature and scan artifacts exist
stop_conditions: Cloud Run resources are enabled by default
Raw secrets are committed
Container runs as root
Production project or domain is required for staging validation

transition_targets.label: Isolated Cloud SQL and Cloud Run staging resources are applied
required_actions: Select a dedicated staging project and approved billing account
Set a CAD 50 staging budget and Toronto primary region
Configure remote Terraform state and least-privilege WIF/IAM
Accept read-only provider-discovery evidence
Generate and review a provider-backed saved plan
Issue single-use SIA authorization and apply the exact reviewed plan
required_evidence: Budget and alert evidence without sensitive billing identifiers
SIP plan receipt, saved-plan digest, SIA apply receipt and execution receipt
Cloud SQL and Cloud Run resource references
stop_conditions: Production project or customer data is selected
Plan digest or revision changes
Apply authorization is expired or reused
Public database exposure or broad IAM appears
Unexpected resources appear in the plan

transition_targets.label: Canary A platform proof passes
required_actions: Authenticate an allowlisted operator
Verify /health and PostgreSQL connectivity
Run migrations and create a basic internal work order
Verify governance artifacts, persistence and audit evidence
Observe logs, metrics, alerts and budget notifications
Perform rollback and isolated database restore tests
required_evidence: Rollback, backup restore, RPO and RTO measurements
stop_conditions: Authentication or tenant isolation fails
Migration or transaction tests fail
Alerts are not delivered
Rollback or restore cannot be demonstrated

transition_targets.label: PR #122 is reconstructed with employer-duty synthesis scope
required_actions: Reconstruct the Jobs and Interviews cockpit on proven main
Preserve read-only opportunity discovery and truthful qualification controls
Implement EmployerDutyWorkOrderSynthesizer from issue #128
Extend the work-order contract with source traceability, duties, dependencies, KPIs, gaps and revision history
Run complete tests and hosted CI
required_evidence: No external submission or messaging tests
Hosted CI, exact-head review and separate disposition
stop_conditions: Authoritative work order is created before WORK_ACCEPTED or verified assignment evidence
AI inference is represented as employer fact
Skills or credentials are fabricated
External commitment authority is introduced

transition_targets.label: Canary B employer-duty autonomy proof passes
required_actions: Use a verified job source and qualified accepted Quest
Generate duty normalization, traceability, best-practice mapping and capability-gap analysis
Generate autonomous work breakdown, KPI plan and governed internal execution artifacts
Introduce one verified employer amendment
Verify revision diff, impact analysis and consequential-change escalation
required_evidence: Employer source snapshot and duty register
stop_conditions: Traceability is incomplete
Replay creates duplicates
Contradictions are silently resolved
Scope, price, deadline or contract changes bypass review

transition_targets.label: One approved read-only connector is operationally proven
required_actions: Select Gmail read-only search or Google Drive read-only retrieval
Review terms, consent, minimum OAuth scope and revocation path
Resolve credentials only through Secret Manager
Test read-only access, rate limits, attribution, emergency stop and token revocation
required_evidence: Proof that send, mutation, scheduling and external commitments are unavailable
stop_conditions: Write scopes are requested
Raw token or secret values are logged
Revocation or emergency stop fails
Connector can send, modify or schedule

safety_invariants.label: Direct write to main is allowed
safety_invariants.rationale: All changes require a bounded branch, hosted evidence, technical review and separate operator disposition.
enforcement_tests: No contents API write targets main
Every change is associated with a draft PR

safety_invariants.label: AIGC may approve its own work
safety_invariants.rationale: Technical evidence generation and accountable judgment remain separate functions.

safety_invariants.label: Automatic merge is allowed
safety_invariants.rationale: Merge is consequential repository mutation and requires a separate expected-head decision.

safety_invariants.label: AIGC may automatically commit the operator to external obligations
safety_invariants.rationale: Employment, contract, scope, price, deadline, submission, communication and delivery commitments require separate authority.

safety_invariants.label: Local evidence may replace hosted CI
safety_invariants.rationale: Local bundles are supplemental and cannot prove runner execution or authorize merge.
enforcement_tests: Admission requires hosted steps and artifacts

safety_invariants.label: Raw secrets may be committed or logged
safety_invariants.rationale: Only secret references are allowed; values remain in approved secret managers.

safety_invariants.label: PR #129 itself performs cloud or counterparty action
safety_invariants.rationale: This branch procures contracts, plans and validators only; later execution receipts record separately authorized actions.
enforcement_tests: external_action_performed remains false in coordination artifacts
No provider, messaging or submission call exists

safety_invariants.label: AIGC may automatically submit job applications in the current release
safety_invariants.rationale: Current Jobs and Interviews scope prepares truthful review packets; platform-specific submission remains separately reviewed and authorized.
enforcement_tests: Application approval means manual operator submission only

decision_lineage.decision: Authority statements authorize attempts but do not instantiate missing evidence.
decision_lineage.effect: GAR, GHR, hosted steps, artifacts and reviews must be genuine before truth values change.

decision_lineage.decision: The proper live target is an isolated staging pilot, not full production.
decision_lineage.effect: Cloud resources remain project-isolated, budget-bounded and free of customer data.

decision_lineage.decision: Hosted CI recovery and PR #123 admission precede downstream implementation.
decision_lineage.effect: PR #121, PR #122, PR #129 and later trains require reconstruction or rebinding after main moves.

decision_lineage.decision: Cloud Run and Canary A platform proof precede employer-duty autonomy.
decision_lineage.effect: Issue #128 is Canary B and cannot block initial platform proof.

decision_lineage.decision: Authoritative employer-duty work orders begin only after WORK_ACCEPTED or equivalent verified assignment evidence.
decision_lineage.effect: Opportunity discovery may create previews but not authoritative obligations.

decision_lineage.decision: Internal planning, work-order creation, analytics and reconciliation may be autonomous while external commitments remain gated.
decision_lineage.effect: AIGC gains operational autonomy without self-approval, silent contract changes or uncontrolled outward action.

decision_lineage.decision: A false value is not automatically a defect.
decision_lineage.effect: Completion targets are procured toward true; safety invariants are tested and intentionally preserved as false.
